newsitem.title: USA: U.S. window washer lands on his feet, survives fall.
newsitem.headline: U.S. window washer lands on his feet, survives fall.

text.p: A window washer survived a 90-foot (27-metre) fall by landing on his feet on a thick layer of mud, authorities said on Thursday.
"If he had fallen any other way it would have killed him," paramedic David Kingsbury said of the cat-like landing.
Maxium Maldano, 23, was working outside the top floor of an eight-story office building in Nashville, Tennessee, on Wednesday when his safety rigging broke and he plunged to the muddy ground.
"To fall from that height and live to tell about it, that's pretty rare. We figured he'd be dead before we got there," Kingsbury said.
A hospital spokesman said Maldano was in critical but stable condition with a broken pelvis and several broken bones in his legs.
